products.title: DEMCO Series NE-C Lug Butterfly Valve, 12″, 200 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco ne-c lug butterfly valve 12 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve in 12 in (300 mm) is a long-neck, general-purpose ductile iron valve with a 200 psi drop-tight cartridge seat in an ASME Class 150 body. The size table lists 7 part numbers, led by base 22127, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve 12 inch is a 200 psi drop-tight butterfly valve for between-flange mounting, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and supplied by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. It fits a 300 mm line, sits in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and weighs 98.5 lb (44.7 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22127, 22233 and 22251 for the size.

How it is built

NE-C is the long-neck, general-purpose DEMCO body, so the neck clears 2 in of insulation on ASME Class 150 flanges. The body is one piece, with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs gives a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 7 part numbers for 12 in.

  • Face to face (A): 82 mm; C 310 mm, D 551 mm, E 409 mm; bolt circle J 432 mm.
  • Ratings: 200 psi drop-tight as standard (base 22127), 285 psi (base 22233), throttling disc (base 22251).
  • Wet opening torque: 7,000 in·lbf at 285 psi, 4,500 at 200 psi, 3,000 at 50 psi and 1,160 throttling.
  • Fit: between ASME Class 125/150 flanges; vacuum 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The lug body is listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

Take J022127-5114311. J0 marks a non-fire-safe build (F0 is the fire-safe prefix for marine use), 22127 is the base number for this size at 200 psi, then body configuration 5 (lug), body material 1 (ductile iron (lug)), stem 1 (416 SS), disc 4 (aluminium bronze), seat 31 (Buna-N) and operator 1 (ten-position handle). The nameplate governs if a plate differs from the table.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22242. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base or assembly number, size, rating, end connection, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. If the line may need a different size, compare the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 10 in; all butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

faqs.question: What are the face-to-face length and weight of the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 12 in?

faqs.question: What materials and trim are offered on the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 12 in?

faqs.question: Which seat elastomer suits the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 12 in, and what temperatures apply?
faqs.answer: Match the seat on the 12 in DEMCO NE-C lug valve to the fluid: Buna-N for hydrocarbon and petroleum, EPDM for water, saturated steam and alkalis, FKM for harsh chemicals, natural rubber for abrasion. Limits are 0 to 180 °F (−18 to 82 °C), 20 to 275 °F (−6 to 135 °C), 20 to 300 °F (−6 to 149 °C) and −30 to 150 °F (−34 to 65 °C) in that order. faqs.question: Which spare parts fit the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 12 in?

faqs.question: What testing and approvals apply to the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 12 in?

faqs.question: How is the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 12 in, installed and operated?
faqs.answer: Install the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 12 in, closed between flanges with studs or capscrews. The lug body carries L 12 lugs/studs, thread K 7/8-9. faqs.question: Can the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 12 in, be used for end-of-line service?
faqs.answer: Yes, the catalogue lists the DEMCO NE-C lug body as end-of-line service capable, including at 12 in. Face to face is 82 mm and weight is 98.5 lb (44.7 kg) bare stem. Confirm the pressure and flange arrangement with us before you rely on dead-end isolation.

If you already hold a nameplate for the DEMCO NE-C lug valve, include that number.

products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve in 4 in (100 mm) is a long-neck, general-purpose ductile iron valve with a 200 psi drop-tight cartridge seat in an ASME Class 150 body. The size table lists 7 part numbers, led by base 22122, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve 4 inch is a 200 psi drop-tight butterfly valve for between-flange mounting, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and supplied by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. It fits a 100 mm line, sits in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and weighs 17.0 lb (7.7 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22122, 22228 and 22246 for the size.

How it is built

NE-C is the long-neck, general-purpose DEMCO body, so the neck clears 2 in of insulation on ASME Class 150 flanges. The body is one piece, with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs gives a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 7 part numbers for 4 in.

  • Face to face (A): 54 mm; C 181 mm, D 279 mm, E 175 mm; bolt circle J 191 mm.
  • Ratings: 200 psi drop-tight as standard (base 22122), 285 psi (base 22228), throttling disc (base 22246).
  • Wet opening torque: 765 in·lbf at 285 psi, 450 at 200 psi, 264 at 50 psi and 108 throttling.
  • Fit: between ASME Class 125/150 flanges; vacuum 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The lug body is listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

Take J022122-5115311. J0 marks a non-fire-safe build (F0 is the fire-safe prefix for marine use), 22122 is the base number for this size at 200 psi, then body configuration 5 (lug), body material 1 (ductile iron (lug)), stem 1 (416 SS), disc 5 (nickel-plated ductile iron), seat 31 (Buna-N) and operator 1 (ten-position handle). The nameplate governs if a plate differs from the table.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22237. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base or assembly number, size, rating, end connection, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. If the line may need a different size, compare the DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 3 in; all butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

products.title: DEMCO Series NE-C Wafer Butterfly Valve, 2″, 200 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco ne-c wafer butterfly valve 2 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve in 2 in (50 mm) is a long-neck, general-purpose ductile iron valve with a 200 psi drop-tight cartridge seat in an ASME Class 150 body. The size table lists 10 part numbers, led by base 22119, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve 2 inch is a 200 psi drop-tight butterfly valve for between-flange mounting, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and supplied by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. It fits a 50 mm line, sits in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and weighs 5.8 lb (2.6 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22119, 22225 and 22243 for the size.

How it is built

NE-C is the long-neck, general-purpose DEMCO body, so the neck clears 2 in of insulation on ASME Class 150 flanges. The body is one piece, with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs gives a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 10 part numbers for 2 in.

  • Face to face (A): 44 mm; C 143 mm, D 214 mm, E 105 mm; bolt circle J 121 mm.
  • Ratings: 200 psi drop-tight as standard (base 22119), 285 psi (base 22225), throttling disc (base 22243).
  • Wet opening torque: 225 in·lbf at 285 psi, 132 at 200 psi, 108 at 50 psi and 72 throttling.
  • Fit: between ASME Class 125/150 flanges; vacuum 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The wafer body is not listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

Take J022119-1214311. J0 marks a non-fire-safe build (F0 is the fire-safe prefix for marine use), 22119 is the base number for this size at 200 psi, then body configuration 1 (wafer), body material 2 (ductile iron (wafer)), stem 1 (416 SS), disc 4 (aluminium bronze), seat 31 (Buna-N) and operator 1 (ten-position handle). The nameplate governs if a plate differs from the table.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22234. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base or assembly number, size, rating, end connection, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. If the line may need a different size, compare the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2-1/2 in; all butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

faqs.question: What pressure rating and base numbers apply to the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in?
faqs.answer: Three base numbers cover the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve at 2 in: 22119 for 200 psi drop-tight, 22225 for 285 psi and 22243 for throttling. Choose by duty, since wet opening torque is 108 in·lbf at 50 psi, 132 in·lbf at 200 psi and 225 in·lbf at 285 psi.

faqs.question: What materials and trim are offered on the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in?
faqs.answer: For the 2 in NE-C wafer valve, DEMCO lists body ductile iron (ASTM A395) as standard, with aluminium bronze, carbon steel and SS options. The stem is 416 SS as standard with 316 SS as an option, with a choice of nickel-plated ductile iron, aluminium bronze, 316 SS or ZPEX-coated ductile iron discs. Photographed: J022119-1214311 (416 SS stem, aluminium bronze disc, Buna-N). Where a plate differs from this list, the nameplate governs.

faqs.question: Which seat elastomer suits the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in, and what temperatures apply?
faqs.answer: Buna-N (0 to 180 °F) is the usual choice for hydrocarbon service on the DEMCO NE-C wafer valve at 2 in. EPDM suits water and saturated steam to 275 °F but not oil, and FKM runs to 300 °F but not hot water or steam. Natural rubber handles abrasive dry material from −30 to 150 °F. Seats seen on photographed nameplates here: Buna-N (J022119-1214311), FKM (J022119-1224341).

faqs.question: How do I read a part number for the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in?
faqs.answer: Split J022119-1214311 at the dash: J022119 is the non-fire-safe prefix plus the 2 in base number, and 1214311 gives wafer, ductile iron (wafer), 416 SS stem, aluminium bronze disc, Buna-N seat and ten-position handle. Use F0 instead of J0 for fire-safe marine builds.

faqs.question: Which spare parts fit the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in?
faqs.answer: Order a seat as 1786-XXX, a disc as 200 22045-0XX, a bearing as 22526-001 or a stem O-ring as 5526-113 for the 2 in DEMCO NE-C wafer valve. The suffix on the seat and disc numbers follows the elastomer and material, confirmed at quotation. Quote the nameplate number with the request.

faqs.question: What testing and approvals apply to the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in?
faqs.answer: Fire testing to API 607 4th Ed exists only on selected sizes and ratings, ordered with the F0 prefix; check whether the 2 in NE-C wafer DEMCO valve, base 22119, is among them. The same limit applies to ABS, DNV, CE/PED, CRN and EAC, while MSS SP-67 testing is on request and MSS SP-25 sets the marking.

faqs.question: How does the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in, compare with its neighbours in the range?
faqs.answer: Choose between wafer (5.8 lb) and lug (8.0 lb) bare-stem weights on the DEMCO NE-C 2 in, then check the line: only lug is listed for end-of-line service. The lug listing is [DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve, 2 in](/p/demco-series-ne-c-lug-butterfly-valve-2-inch-200-psi). Both share the long-neck, general-purpose NE-C neck, unlike NE-D, whose short neck is cut away for lightweight flange patterns.

faqs.question: How is the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in, installed and operated?
faqs.answer: Handle or gear, the 2 in NE-C wafer valve from DEMCO is installed closed between flanges and then left alone: no regular maintenance or lubrication is listed. 2 in sits below the 8–12 in band where a gear operator is recommended, so it is normally handle-operated; gear 22622 (30:1, 7-1/2 turns per 90°) is the catalogue gear for the band. The wafer body self-centres in the Class 150 bolt pattern. Opening torque at 200 psi is 132 in·lbf.

faqs.question: Can the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in, be used for end-of-line service?
faqs.answer: For dead-end isolation the DEMCO NE-C 2 in wafer valve is not the listed choice, because end-of-line service is not shown for the wafer body. A lug body, with L 4 lugs/studs at this size, is the listed route; the wafer stays for in-line duty.

faqs.question: How do I order the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 2 in?
faqs.answer: Write to Indus Hydraulics through [/contact](/contact) with the 2 in NE-C wafer number (base 22119 at 200 psi, 22225 at 285 psi), the end connection, seat elastomer and quantity. Quotations are issued from Dubai, UAE, and we confirm the full configuration number then.

products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve in 4 in (100 mm) is a long-neck, general-purpose ductile iron valve with a 200 psi drop-tight cartridge seat in an ASME Class 150 body. The size table lists 8 part numbers, led by base 22122, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve 4 inch is a 200 psi drop-tight butterfly valve for between-flange mounting, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and supplied by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. It fits a 100 mm line, sits in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and weighs 11.4 lb (5.2 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22122, 22228 and 22246 for the size.

How it is built

NE-C is the long-neck, general-purpose DEMCO body, so the neck clears 2 in of insulation on ASME Class 150 flanges. The body is one piece, with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs gives a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 8 part numbers for 4 in.

  • Face to face (A): 54 mm; C 181 mm, D 279 mm, E 175 mm; bolt circle J 191 mm.
  • Ratings: 200 psi drop-tight as standard (base 22122), 285 psi (base 22228), throttling disc (base 22246).
  • Wet opening torque: 765 in·lbf at 285 psi, 450 at 200 psi, 264 at 50 psi and 108 throttling.
  • Fit: between ASME Class 125/150 flanges; vacuum 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The wafer body is not listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

Take J022122-1212311. J0 marks a non-fire-safe build (F0 is the fire-safe prefix for marine use), 22122 is the base number for this size at 200 psi, then body configuration 1 (wafer), body material 2 (ductile iron (wafer)), stem 1 (416 SS), disc 2 (316 SS), seat 31 (Buna-N) and operator 1 (ten-position handle). The nameplate governs if a plate differs from the table.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22237. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base or assembly number, size, rating, end connection, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. If the line may need a different size, compare the DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 3 in; all butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

The DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve 4 inch is a 200 psi drop-tight butterfly valve for between-flange mounting, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and supplied by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. It fits a 100 mm line, sits in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and weighs 10.2 lb (4.6 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22183, 22281 and 22293 for the size.

How it is built

NE-D is the short-neck DEMCO body with notches cut for lightweight flange patterns, aimed at bulk material handling and transport, and it centres in ASME 125/150 flanges. The body is one piece, with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs gives a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 7 part numbers for 4 in.

  • Face to face (A): 54 mm; C 152 mm, D 251 mm, E 175 mm; bolt circle J 179 mm.
  • Ratings: 200 psi drop-tight as standard (base 22183), 285 psi (base 22281), throttling disc (base 22293).
  • Wet opening torque: 765 in·lbf at 285 psi, 450 at 200 psi, 264 at 50 psi and 108 throttling.
  • Fit: between ASME Class 125/150 flanges; vacuum 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The wafer body is not listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

Take J022183-1115311. J0 marks a non-fire-safe build (F0 is the fire-safe prefix for marine use), 22183 is the base number for this size at 200 psi, then body configuration 1 (wafer), body material 1 (ductile iron), stem 1 (416 SS), disc 5 (nickel-plated ductile iron), seat 31 (Buna-N) and operator 1 (ten-position handle). The nameplate governs if a plate differs from the table.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22287. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in, and where is it used?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve in 6 in is a short-neck ductile iron valve for isolating or throttling a 150 mm line between ASME Class 125/150 flanges. The seat chosen sets the service, from hydrocarbon and petroleum to water, alkalis and harsh chemicals, with base 22185 for 200 psi drop-tight shut-off.

faqs.question: What pressure rating and base numbers apply to the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve in 6 in is rated 200 psi drop-tight as standard under base 22185, inside an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock). The 285 psi option is base 22283 and the throttling disc is base 22295. Wet opening torque is 900 in·lbf at 200 psi and 1,530 in·lbf at 285 psi.

faqs.question: What are the face-to-face length and weight of the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve in 6 in has a face-to-face dimension (A) of 57 mm and weighs 16.4 lb (7.4 kg) with a bare stem. The catalogue also gives C 165 mm, D 292 mm, E 222 mm and bolt circle J 233 mm. The square-stem NE-D SP part 2326566 is tabled at 53.85 mm face to face.

faqs.question: What materials and trim are offered on the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in?
faqs.answer: On the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve in 6 in, the body is ductile iron. The stem is 416 SS as standard with 316 SS as an option, and discs come in nickel-plated ductile iron, aluminium bronze or 316 SS. Photographed: J022185-1115311 (416 SS stem, nickel-plated ductile iron disc, Buna-N).

faqs.question: Which seat elastomer suits the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in, and what temperatures apply?
faqs.answer: Match the seat on the 6 in DEMCO NE-D wafer valve to the fluid: Buna-N for hydrocarbon and petroleum, EPDM for water, saturated steam and alkalis, FKM for harsh chemicals, natural rubber for abrasion. Limits are 0 to 180 °F (−18 to 82 °C), 20 to 275 °F (−6 to 135 °C), 20 to 300 °F (−6 to 149 °C) and −30 to 150 °F (−34 to 65 °C) in that order. Seats seen on photographed nameplates here: Buna-N (J022185-1115311).

faqs.question: How do I read a part number for the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in?
faqs.answer: Take J022185-1115311 on the DEMCO NE-D wafer 6 in valve: J0 is non-fire-safe, 22185 is the base number, then 1 = wafer, 1 = ductile iron, 1 = 416 SS stem, 5 = nickel-plated ductile iron disc, 31 = Buna-N seat and 1 = ten-position handle. An F0 prefix would mark a fire-safe build.

faqs.question: Which spare parts fit the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in?
faqs.answer: The catalogue parts list for 6 in gives seat 1002-XXX, disc 200 22050-0XX, bearing 13115-001 and stem O-ring 5526-212 for the DEMCO NE-D wafer valve. The seat is a slip-fit cartridge, so it changes without special tools. The XXX suffixes are confirmed at quotation.

faqs.question: What testing and approvals apply to the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-D wafer valve in 6 in follows MSS SP-67 (testing on request) and MSS SP-25 marking. ABS, CE/PED, CRN, DNV, EAC and API 607 4th Ed fire-test builds apply on selected sizes and ratings only, so confirm 6 in at 200 psi (base 22185) before relying on one. Fire-safe builds take the F0 prefix.

faqs.question: How does the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in, compare with its neighbours in the range?
faqs.answer: NE-D at 6 in is the short-neck, lightweight-flange body at 16.4 lb bare stem, while NE-C is the long-neck general-purpose body; see [DEMCO NE-C wafer butterfly valve, 6 in](/p/demco-series-ne-c-wafer-butterfly-valve-6-inch-200-psi). Both are ductile iron and rated 200 psi drop-tight, and each has 200 psi, 285 psi and throttling base numbers; here they are 22185, 22283 and 22295.

faqs.question: How is the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in, installed and operated?
faqs.answer: Install the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in, closed between flanges with studs or capscrews. The wafer body self-centres in the Class 150 bolt pattern. 6 in sits below the 8–12 in band where a gear operator is recommended, so it is normally handle-operated; gear 22622 (30:1, 7-1/2 turns per 90°) is the catalogue gear for the band. It needs no regular maintenance or lubrication; wet opening torque is 900 in·lbf at 200 psi.

faqs.question: Can the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in, be used for end-of-line service?
faqs.answer: The catalogue does not list the DEMCO NE-D wafer body at 6 in as end-of-line service capable, so keep it in line with pipe on both sides. For dead-end duty at 6 in, ask us about the NE-C lug body, which is listed for end-of-line service.

faqs.question: How do I order the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in?
faqs.answer: Send the base or assembly number (22185, 22283 or 22295), size 6 in, rating, end connection, seat elastomer and quantity through [our contact page](/contact), and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. If you already hold a nameplate for the DEMCO NE-D wafer valve, include that number.

products.title: DEMCO Series NE-I Lug Butterfly Valve, 2½″, 200 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco ne-i lug butterfly valve 2½ inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-I lug butterfly valve in 2½ in (65 mm) is a short-neck valve for between-flange mounting, with 200 psi drop-tight shut-off on base 22129, 47 mm face to face and 8.9 lb bare stem, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-I lug butterfly valve 2½ inch is a short-neck butterfly valve for food and beverage, utilities and process flowlines, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and quoted by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. At 2½ in (65 mm) the lug body shuts off drop-tight at 200 psi as standard, measures 47 mm face to face and weighs 8.9 lb (4.0 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22129 (200 psi), 22253 (285 psi) and 22271 (throttling) for the size.

How it is built

Inside the 2½ in lug body sits a hard-backed cartridge seat, part 1788-XXX, bonded to a rigid backing ring and replaced without special tools. The stem has a dry journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs, which is the triple stem seal, and the positively oriented disc seals in either flow direction at full rating. An integral flange seal covers weld-neck, slip-on, threaded, socket and stub-end type C flanges.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 5 part-number lines for 2½ in. The valve sits between ASME Class 125/150 flanges in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and is rated for vacuum to 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). Wet opening torque is 326 in·lbf at 285 psi, 192 in·lbf at 200 psi, 108 in·lbf at 50 psi, 72 in·lbf with the throttling disc.

  • Face to face (A): 47 mm, with C 113 mm, D 191 mm and E 124 mm.
  • Bolting: bolt circle J 135 mm, thread K 3/8, L 4.
  • Gear operator: 22622, 30:1, 7-1/2 turns per 90°; gear is recommended for 8–12 in.
  • End of line: The lug body is listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

The photographed nameplate J022129-5114341 reads base 22129 (J0 non-fire-safe), then 5 = lug, 1 = body code 1 (ductile iron in the table, which lists it as wafer only, so the nameplate governs), 1 = 416 SS stem, 4 = aluminium bronze disc, 34 = FKM seat, 1 = ten-position handle. F0 replaces J0 for a fire-safe build, and the nameplate governs if a plate differs from the ordering table.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22262. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base number, size, rating, end connection, trim, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Compare the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2½ in and the next size, 3 in if the line or duty may change. All butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve in 2 in (50 mm) is a short-neck valve for between-flange mounting, with 200 psi drop-tight shut-off on base 22128, 44 mm face to face and 4.9 lb bare stem, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 inch is a short-neck butterfly valve for food and beverage, utilities and process flowlines, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and quoted by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. At 2 in (50 mm) the wafer body shuts off drop-tight at 200 psi as standard, measures 44 mm face to face and weighs 4.9 lb (2.2 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22128 (200 psi), 22252 (285 psi) and 22270 (throttling) for the size.

How it is built

The body is one piece with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools, using seat part 1786-XXX at 2 in. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs forms a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating, and an integral flange seal suits weld-neck, slip-on, threaded, socket and stub-end type C flanges.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 7 part-number lines for 2 in. The valve sits between ASME Class 125/150 flanges in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and is rated for vacuum to 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). Wet opening torque is 225 in·lbf at 285 psi, 132 in·lbf at 200 psi, 108 in·lbf at 50 psi, 72 in·lbf with the throttling disc.

  • Face to face (A): 44 mm, with C 100 mm, D 171 mm and E 105 mm.
  • Bolting: bolt circle J 108 mm, thread K 3/8, L 4.
  • Gear operator: 22622, 30:1, 7-1/2 turns per 90°; gear is recommended for 8–12 in.
  • End of line: The wafer body is not listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

The photographed nameplate J022128-1112361 reads base 22128 (J0 non-fire-safe), then 1 = wafer, 1 = ductile iron, 1 = 416 SS stem, 2 = 316 SS disc, 36 = natural rubber seat, 1 = ten-position handle. F0 replaces J0 for a fire-safe build, and the nameplate governs if a plate differs from the ordering table.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22261. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base number, size, rating, end connection, trim, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Compare the DEMCO NE-I lug butterfly valve 2 in and the next size, 2½ in if the line or duty may change. All butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in used for?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in is a short-neck butterfly valve for food and beverage, utilities and process flowlines, fitted between ASME Class 125/150 flanges. At 2 in (50 mm) it is built on base 22128, with a face-to-face length of 44 mm and a bare-stem weight of 4.9 lb.

faqs.question: What pressure rating does the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in have?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in shuts off drop-tight at 200 psi as standard, with 285 psi and 50 psi options and a throttling (0 psi) disc for non-shut-off duty. The body is ASME Class 150 (285 psi non-shock). Wet opening torque at 2 in is 225 in·lbf at 285 psi, 132 in·lbf at 200 psi, 108 in·lbf at 50 psi, 72 in·lbf with the throttling disc.

faqs.question: What are the dimensions and weight of the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in is 44 mm face to face (dimension A), with C 100, D 171 and E 105 mm in the size table. Bare-stem weight is 4.9 lb (2.2 kg); the lug body of the same size is listed at 7.0 lb.

faqs.question: What materials is the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in made from?
faqs.answer: On the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in the body is ductile iron (wafer), with aluminium bronze, carbon steel and stainless steel bodies also listed. The stem is 416 SS stem as standard with a 316 SS option, and the disc is nickel-plated ductile iron, aluminium bronze or 316 SS, with a ZPEX-coated ductile iron option. Disc part 200 22045-0XX applies at 2 in.

faqs.question: Which seat elastomer should I choose for the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in?
faqs.answer: Choose the seat of the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in to suit the fluid. Buna-N runs 0 to 180 °F (−18 to 82 °C) on hydrocarbon and petroleum lines, and EPDM runs 20 to 275 °F (−6 to 135 °C) on water, saturated steam and alkalis but not oil. Cartridge seat part 1786-XXX is the 2 in size. The photographed nameplates for 2 in carry natural rubber and Buna-N and FKM seats.

faqs.question: How do I read a DEMCO NE-I part number such as the 2 in wafer 22128 build?
faqs.answer: The number reads prefix, base, dash, then six groups of digits. J022128-1112361 reads base 22128 (J0 non-fire-safe), then 1 = wafer, 1 = ductile iron, 1 = 416 SS stem, 2 = 316 SS disc, 36 = natural rubber seat, 1 = ten-position handle. A second photographed unit, J022128-1114311, follows the same digit order.

faqs.question: Which spare parts does the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in use?
faqs.answer: At 2 in the catalogue lists seat 1786-XXX, disc 200 22045-0XX, bearing 22526-001 and stem O-ring 5526-113. The seat is a slip-fit cartridge that is replaced without special tools; the suffix on seat and disc is completed to match the elastomer and trim at quotation.

faqs.question: Which tests and standards apply to the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in follows MSS SP-67 (testing on request) and MSS SP-25 marking, and is rated for vacuum to 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). ABS, CE/PED, CRN, DNV, EAC and API 607 4th Ed fire-test builds apply on selected sizes and ratings only, so base 22128 at 2 in is confirmed at quotation.

faqs.question: Should I choose a wafer or lug 2 in DEMCO NE-I butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Wafer and lug differ in weight, mounting and end-of-line use. At 2 in the wafer body weighs 4.9 lb against 7.0 lb for the lug body, and only the lug body is listed for end-of-line service. See the [lug 2 in valve](/p/demco-series-ne-i-lug-butterfly-valve-2-inch-200-psi) for its sizes.

faqs.question: How do I install and maintain the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in?
faqs.answer: Install the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in closed between flanges with studs or capscrews; a wafer body self-centres in the Class 150 pattern, and no regular maintenance or lubrication is needed. The dimension table gives bolt circle J 108 mm, thread K 3/8 and L 4 at this size.

faqs.question: Can the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in be used for end-of-line service?
faqs.answer: No, the wafer 2 in body is not listed for end-of-line service. Use the lug body of the same size, base 22128, which weighs 7.0 lb against 4.9 lb for the wafer, and tell us the downstream arrangement when you enquire.

faqs.question: How do I order the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in?
faqs.answer: Send the base number (22128, 22252 or 22270), the size 2 in, rating, wafer body, trim, seat elastomer, actuation and quantity through [/contact](/contact). Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

The DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 4 inch is a short-neck butterfly valve for food and beverage, utilities and process flowlines, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and quoted by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. At 4 in (100 mm) the wafer body shuts off drop-tight at 200 psi as standard, measures 54 mm face to face and weighs 10.2 lb (4.6 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22131 (200 psi), 22255 (285 psi) and 22273 (throttling) for the size.

How it is built

The body is one piece with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools, using seat part 1792-XXX at 4 in. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs forms a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating, and an integral flange seal suits weld-neck, slip-on, threaded, socket and stub-end type C flanges.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 7 part-number lines for 4 in. The valve sits between ASME Class 125/150 flanges in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and is rated for vacuum to 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). Wet opening torque is 765 in·lbf at 285 psi, 450 in·lbf at 200 psi, 264 in·lbf at 50 psi, 108 in·lbf with the throttling disc.

  • Face to face (A): 54 mm, with C 152 mm, D 251 mm and E 175 mm.
  • Bolting: bolt circle J 179 mm, thread K 1/2, L 6.
  • Gear operator: 22622, 30:1, 7-1/2 turns per 90°; gear is recommended for 8–12 in.
  • End of line: The wafer body is not listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

The photographed nameplate J022131-1112311 reads base 22131 (J0 non-fire-safe), then 1 = wafer, 1 = ductile iron, 1 = 416 SS stem, 2 = 316 SS disc, 31 = Buna-N seat, 1 = ten-position handle. F0 replaces J0 for a fire-safe build, and the nameplate governs if a plate differs from the ordering table.

faqs.question: Which seat, disc, bearing and O-ring numbers fit the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 6 in?

products.title: DEMCO Series NE-I Wafer Butterfly Valve, 8″, 200 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco ne-i wafer butterfly valve 8 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve in 8 in (200 mm) is a short-neck valve for between-flange mounting, with 200 psi drop-tight shut-off on base 22134, 65 mm face to face and 28.4 lb bare stem, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 8 inch is a short-neck butterfly valve for food and beverage, utilities and process flowlines, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and quoted by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. At 8 in (200 mm) the wafer body shuts off drop-tight at 200 psi as standard, measures 65 mm face to face and weighs 28.4 lb (12.9 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22134 (200 psi), 22258 (285 psi) and 22276 (throttling) for the size.

How it is built

The body is one piece with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools, using seat part 1798-XXX at 8 in. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs forms a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating, and an integral flange seal suits weld-neck, slip-on, threaded, socket and stub-end type C flanges.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 4 part-number lines for 8 in. The valve sits between ASME Class 125/150 flanges in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and is rated for vacuum to 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). Wet opening torque is 2,550 in·lbf at 285 psi, 1,500 in·lbf at 200 psi, 1,000 in·lbf at 50 psi, 350 in·lbf with the throttling disc.

  • Face to face (A): 65 mm, with C 205 mm, D 360 mm and E 279 mm.
  • Bolting: bolt circle J 298 mm, thread K 5/8, L 8.
  • Gear operator: 22623, 48:1, 12 turns per 90°; gear is recommended for 8–12 in.
  • End of line: The wafer body is not listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

The photographed nameplate J022134-1114341 reads base 22134 (J0 non-fire-safe), then 1 = wafer, 1 = ductile iron, 1 = 416 SS stem, 4 = aluminium bronze disc, 34 = FKM seat, 1 = ten-position handle. F0 replaces J0 for a fire-safe build, and the nameplate governs if a plate differs from the ordering table.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22267. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base number, size, rating, end connection, trim, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Compare the DEMCO NE-I lug butterfly valve 8 in and the next size, 10 in if the line or duty may change. All butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

The DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve 10 inch is a 200 psi drop-tight butterfly valve for between-flange mounting, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and supplied by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. It fits a 250 mm line, sits in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and weighs 65.9 lb (29.9 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22126, 22232 and 22250 for the size.

The body is one piece, with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs gives a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating.

  • Wet opening torque: 4,125 in·lbf at 285 psi, 2,650 at 200 psi, 1,800 at 50 psi and 700 throttling.
  • Fit: between ASME Class 125/150 flanges; vacuum 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The lug body is listed for end-of-line service.

products.focusKeyword: demco ne-i lug butterfly valve 2 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-I lug butterfly valve in 2 in (50 mm) is a short-neck valve for between-flange mounting, with 200 psi drop-tight shut-off on base 22128, 44 mm face to face and 7.0 lb bare stem, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-I lug butterfly valve 2 inch is a short-neck butterfly valve for food and beverage, utilities and process flowlines, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and quoted by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. At 2 in (50 mm) the lug body shuts off drop-tight at 200 psi as standard, measures 44 mm face to face and weighs 7.0 lb (3.2 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22128 (200 psi), 22252 (285 psi) and 22270 (throttling) for the size.

How it is built

DEMCO makes the 2 in body in one piece. The cartridge seat (part 1786-XXX) is bonded to a rigid backing ring and slips in and out without special tools, while the dry stem journal, with its raised annular band and two O-ring ribs, gives a triple stem seal. The disc is driven through a rectangular drive and is sealed in both flow directions at full rating; an integral flange seal removes the need for separate gaskets on weld-neck, slip-on, threaded, socket and stub-end type C flanges.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 3 part-number lines for 2 in. The valve sits between ASME Class 125/150 flanges in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and is rated for vacuum to 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). Wet opening torque is 225 in·lbf at 285 psi, 132 in·lbf at 200 psi, 108 in·lbf at 50 psi, 72 in·lbf with the throttling disc.

  • Face to face (A): 44 mm, with C 100 mm, D 171 mm and E 105 mm.
  • Bolting: bolt circle J 108 mm, thread K 3/8, L 4.
  • Gear operator: 22622, 30:1, 7-1/2 turns per 90°; gear is recommended for 8–12 in.
  • End of line: The lug body is listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

A 2 in number starts with J0 (non-fire-safe) or F0 (fire-safe, marine), then base 22128, 22252 or 22270, a dash, and digits for configuration (1 wafer, 5 lug), body material, stem (1 = 416 SS, 2 = 316 SS), disc, a two-digit seat (31 Buna-N, 34 FKM, 35 EPDM, 36 natural rubber) and actuation. Fire-tested API 607 4th Ed builds exist on selected sizes and ratings only.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22261. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base number, size, rating, end connection, trim, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Compare the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 2 in and the next size, 2½ in if the line or duty may change. All butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

products.title: DEMCO Series NE-I Lug Butterfly Valve, 10″, 200 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco ne-i lug butterfly valve 10 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-I lug butterfly valve in 10 in (250 mm) is a short-neck valve for between-flange mounting, with 200 psi drop-tight shut-off on base 22135, 70 mm face to face and 64.9 lb bare stem, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-I lug butterfly valve 10 inch is a short-neck butterfly valve for food and beverage, utilities and process flowlines, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and quoted by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. At 10 in (250 mm) the lug body shuts off drop-tight at 200 psi as standard, measures 70 mm face to face and weighs 64.9 lb (29.4 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22135 (200 psi), 22259 (285 psi) and 22277 (throttling) for the size.

How it is built

Inside the 10 in lug body sits a hard-backed cartridge seat, part 1815-XXX, bonded to a rigid backing ring and replaced without special tools. The stem has a dry journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs, which is the triple stem seal, and the positively oriented disc seals in either flow direction at full rating. An integral flange seal covers weld-neck, slip-on, threaded, socket and stub-end type C flanges.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 3 part-number lines for 10 in. The valve sits between ASME Class 125/150 flanges in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and is rated for vacuum to 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). Wet opening torque is 4,125 in·lbf at 285 psi, 2,650 in·lbf at 200 psi, 1,800 in·lbf at 50 psi, 700 in·lbf with the throttling disc.

  • Face to face (A): 70 mm, with C 253 mm, D 442 mm and E 340 mm.
  • Bolting: bolt circle J 348 mm, thread K 5/8, L 8.
  • Gear operator: 22623, 48:1, 12 turns per 90°; gear is recommended for 8–12 in.
  • End of line: The lug body is listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

A 10 in number starts with J0 (non-fire-safe) or F0 (fire-safe, marine), then base 22135, 22259 or 22277, a dash, and digits for configuration (1 wafer, 5 lug), body material, stem (1 = 416 SS, 2 = 316 SS), disc, a two-digit seat (31 Buna-N, 34 FKM, 35 EPDM, 36 natural rubber) and actuation. Fire-tested API 607 4th Ed builds exist on selected sizes and ratings only.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22268. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base number, size, rating, end connection, trim, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Compare the DEMCO NE-I wafer butterfly valve 10 in and the next size, 12 in if the line or duty may change. All butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

products.title: DEMCO Series NE-D Wafer Butterfly Valve, 10″, 200 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco ne-d wafer butterfly valve 10 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve in 10 in (250 mm) is a short-neck ductile iron valve with a 200 psi drop-tight cartridge seat in an ASME Class 150 body. The size table lists 5 part numbers, led by base 22186, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve 10 inch is a 200 psi drop-tight butterfly valve for between-flange mounting, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and supplied by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. It fits a 250 mm line, sits in an ASME Class 150 body (285 psi non-shock) and weighs 44.8 lb (20.3 kg) with a bare stem. This page lists the DEMCO base numbers 22186, 22284 and 22296 for the size.

How it is built

NE-D is the short-neck DEMCO body with notches cut for lightweight flange patterns, aimed at bulk material handling and transport, and it centres in ASME 125/150 flanges. The body is one piece, with a hard-backed cartridge seat bonded to a rigid backing ring; the seat is a slip-fit and is replaced without special tools. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs gives a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented through a rectangular drive. Shut-off holds in both flow directions at full rating.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 5 part numbers for 10 in.

  • Face to face (A): 70 mm; C 253 mm, D 442 mm, E 340 mm; bolt circle J 348 mm.
  • Ratings: 200 psi drop-tight as standard (base 22186), 285 psi (base 22284), throttling disc (base 22296).
  • Wet opening torque: 4,125 in·lbf at 285 psi, 2,650 at 200 psi, 1,800 at 50 psi and 700 throttling.
  • Fit: between ASME Class 125/150 flanges; vacuum 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The wafer body is not listed for end-of-line service.

Reading the part number

A 10 in NE-D valve is ordered as J0 (non-fire-safe) or F0 (fire-safe, marine), then base 22186 at 200 psi, a dash and seven characters: body configuration (1 for wafer), body material, stem (1 = 416 SS, 2 = 316 SS), disc, two-digit seat (31 Buna-N, 34 FKM, 35 EPDM, 36 natural rubber) and operator. Fire-tested API 607 4th Ed builds exist on selected sizes and ratings only.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22290. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base or assembly number, size, rating, end connection, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. If the line may need a different size, compare the DEMCO NE-D wafer butterfly valve, 6 in; all butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

products.focusKeyword: demco nf-c butterfly valve 18 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve in 18 in (450 mm) is a wafer or lug valve for ASME Class 150 flanges, with 150 psi drop-tight shut-off on base 23822 and a 285 psi option on 25320, 114 mm face to face, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve 18 inch (450 mm) is a large-bore wafer or lug butterfly valve for ASME Class 150 pipework, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and quoted by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. It shuts off drop-tight at 150 psi as standard on base 23822, with a 285 psi option on base 25320, and measures 114 mm face to face. Bare-stem weight is 97.1 kg (214 lb) wafer or 108.4 kg (239 lb) lug.

How it is built

Bronze bearings on both stems reduce torque on the 18 in valve. The wafer body has two drilled locator lugs top and bottom for ASME Class 150 flanges; the lug body is the one listed for end-of-line use. Inside, a hard-backed cartridge seat is bonded to a rigid backing ring and replaced without special tools, and the dry stem journal with two O-ring ribs forms the triple stem seal.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 4 part-number lines for 18 in. The body is ASME Class 150 (285 psi non-shock) for mounting between ASME Class 125/150 flanges, with vacuum rated to 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). Wet opening torque is 38,400 in·lbf at 285 psi, 12,600 in·lbf at 150 psi and 8,400 in·lbf at 50 psi, 3,400 in·lbf throttling.

  • Face to face (A): 114 mm, with B 329 mm, C 375 mm, D 704 mm and E 517 mm.
  • Bolting: J 578 mm, K 1-1/8-7, L 16.
  • Gear operator: 2060231, 57:1.
  • End of line: lug body, 150 psi, with downstream piping removed.

Reading the part number

A 18 in number starts with J0 (non-fire-safe) or F0 (fire-safe, marine), then base 23822 (150 psi) or 25320 (285 psi), a dash and digits for configuration, body, stem, disc, seat and actuation. The catalogue example 23822-512231A is an 18 in lug at 150 psi with stainless steel trim, a Buna-N seat and a worm gear. Fire-tested API 607 4th Ed builds exist on selected sizes and ratings only.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 24442, 24447. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base number, size, rating, wafer or lug, trim, seat elastomer, operator and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. See the NF-C 14 to 36 in range and the 20 in valve alongside. All butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

faqs.question: Which body, stem and disc materials are offered on the DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve 24 in?

faqs.question: What temperature range does the DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve 24 in cover?
faqs.answer: The seat sets the temperature window of the 24 in valve. FKM runs 20 to 300 °F (−6 to 149 °C) for elevated temperature and harsh chemicals but not hot water or steam, and natural rubber runs −30 to 150 °F (−34 to 65 °C) for abrasion but not oils or solvents.

faqs.question: How is a DEMCO NF-C 24 in part number such as 23824 decoded?

faqs.question: What wear parts are listed for the DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve 24 in?

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve 24 in fire tested or certified?

faqs.question: What changes between 150 psi and 285 psi on the DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve 24 in?

faqs.question: What should I check when fitting the DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve 24 in between flanges?

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve 24 in suitable as an end-of-line valve?

products.focusKeyword: demco nf-c butterfly valve 30 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve in 30 in (750 mm) is a wafer or lug valve for ASME Class 150 flanges, with 150 psi drop-tight shut-off on base 24141 and a 285 psi option on 25323, 165 mm face to face, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve 30 inch (750 mm) is a large-bore wafer or lug butterfly valve for ASME Class 150 pipework, made by DEMCO (Cameron, an SLB company) and quoted by Indus Hydraulics from Dubai, UAE. It shuts off drop-tight at 150 psi as standard on base 24141, with a 285 psi option on base 25323, and measures 165 mm face to face. Bare-stem weight is 424.1 kg (935 lb) wafer or 476.3 kg (1,050 lb) lug.

How it is built

Bronze bearings on both stems reduce torque on the 30 in valve. The wafer body has two drilled locator lugs top and bottom for ASME Class 150 flanges; the lug body is the one listed for end-of-line use. Inside, a hard-backed cartridge seat is bonded to a rigid backing ring and replaced without special tools, and the dry stem journal with two O-ring ribs forms the triple stem seal.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 4 part-number lines for 30 in. The body is ASME Class 150 (285 psi non-shock) for mounting between ASME Class 125/150 flanges, with vacuum rated to 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). Wet opening torque is 82,000 in·lbf at 285 psi, 50,000 in·lbf at 150 psi and 30,000 in·lbf at 50 psi.

  • Face to face (A): 165 mm, with B 538 mm, C 584 mm, D 1,123 mm and E 866 mm.
  • Bolting: J 914 mm, K 1-1/4-7 UNC, L 28.
  • Gear operator: 2060332, 316:1.
  • End of line: lug body, 150 psi, with downstream piping removed.

Reading the part number

A 30 in number starts with J0 (non-fire-safe) or F0 (fire-safe, marine), then base 24141 (150 psi) or 25323 (285 psi), a dash and digits for configuration, body, stem, disc, seat and actuation. The catalogue example 23822-512231A is an 18 in lug at 150 psi with stainless steel trim, a Buna-N seat and a worm gear. Fire-tested API 607 4th Ed builds exist on selected sizes and ratings only.

50 psi rating in the 2015 catalogue

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 24924. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

How to order

Send the base number, size, rating, wafer or lug, trim, seat elastomer, operator and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. See the NF-C 14 to 36 in range and the 36 in valve alongside. All butterfly valves are grouped under butterfly valves.

The DEMCO Series NE-C is a long-neck, general-purpose butterfly valve in 2–12 in (50–300 mm), supplied as a wafer or lug body. The body is one piece. The hard-backed cartridge seat is bonded to a rigid backing ring, slip-fits into the body and is replaced without special tools. A dry stem journal with a raised annular band and two O-ring ribs forms a triple stem seal, and the disc is positively oriented by a rectangular drive. Sealing is bidirectional at full rating, with a vacuum rating of 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The body is ASME Class 150 (285 psi non-shock), and the wafer body self-centres in a Class 150 pattern.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

The size table lists 72 part numbers: nine sizes from 2 in to 12 in, each as wafer and lug (the two share a base number), at 200 psi drop-tight shut-off, 285 psi and throttling (0 psi). A 50 psi option also exists. The valve fits between ASME Class 125/150 flanges.

faqs.question: What are the body, stem and disc materials of the DEMCO NE-C butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-C body is ductile iron (ASTM A395), coded 1 for lug and 2 for wafer in the part number. Stems are 416 SS or 316 SS, with a 17-4PH upper stem on 8–12 in. Discs are nickel-plated ductile iron, aluminium bronze or 316 SS. If the nameplate on an installed valve reads differently, the nameplate governs.

faqs.question: Which seat elastomer suits a DEMCO NE-C butterfly valve, and what temperatures apply?
faqs.answer: Match the elastomer to the fluid. Buna-N (seat code 31) runs 0 to 180 °F for hydrocarbons; EPDM (35) runs 20 to 275 °F for water and saturated steam but not oil; FKM (34) runs 20 to 300 °F for harsh chemicals; natural rubber (36) runs −30 to 150 °F for abrasion. These limits apply to the 2–12 in NE-C range.

faqs.question: How do I read a DEMCO NE-C part number such as J0 22119?
faqs.answer: Read it as prefix, base number, hyphen, then digits. J0 22119-1 2 1 2 31 1 is a non-fire-safe 2 in, 200 psi valve: 1 wafer, 2 ductile iron wafer body, 1 for the 416 SS stem, 2 for the 316 SS disc, 31 Buna-N seat and 1 for a ten-position handle. Use F0 for the fire-safe prefix.

faqs.question: Which repair parts fit the DEMCO NE-C 2–12 in butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: The cartridge seat, disc, stems, bearings, pins and O-rings are separate parts, and the seat slips out of the NE-C body without special tools. Quote the valve base number, for example 22123 for a 5 in at 200 psi, with the elastomer. See the [replacement seats](/p/demco-butterfly-valve-replacement-seats-2-24) and discs listings for the numbers.

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO NE-C butterfly valve fire tested or certified?
faqs.answer: Fire-tested API 607 4th Ed builds of the DEMCO NE-C exist, ordered with the F0 prefix, on selected sizes and ratings only. ABS, CE/PED, CRN, DNV and EAC are likewise available on selected sizes and ratings. Testing to MSS SP-67 is available on request, so state the standard when you quote a 10 in or 12 in valve.

faqs.question: How does the DEMCO NE-C differ from the NE-I at 2 in?
faqs.answer: The NE-C has the longer neck, which is what lets the operator clear 2 in of insulation. At 2 in its dimension C is 143 mm and D 214 mm, the 2 in wafer weighs 2.6 kg and the 200 psi base is 22119. The NE-I is the shorter pattern, so check its own listing for dimensions.

faqs.question: What torque and installation steps apply to a DEMCO NE-C butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Install the DEMCO NE-C closed between flanges, with studs or capscrews, and no regular maintenance or lubrication is needed. Published operating torque at 285 psi is 225 in·lbf at 2 in, 1,530 in·lbf at 6 in and 7,000 in·lbf at 12 in. At 200 psi a 12 in valve needs 4,500 in·lbf, so size the operator for the rating.

faqs.question: Can the DEMCO NE-C butterfly valve be used for end-of-line service?
faqs.answer: No. The DEMCO NE-C is not rated for end-of-line service, so downstream flanging or a blind flange is needed when a 3 in or 8 in line is opened to atmosphere. Use it for isolation and throttling in-line between ASME Class 125/150 flanges, bidirectional at full rating.

faqs.question: How do I order a DEMCO NE-C butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Send the base number or size, rating (200 psi, 285 psi or throttling), wafer or lug, body, disc, seat elastomer, operator and quantity through [our contact page](/contact). For a 3 in lug at 285 psi, for example, quote base 22227. Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

products.title: DEMCO Series NE-I Short-Neck Butterfly Valve, 2″–12″
products.focusKeyword: demco ne-i butterfly valve
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO Series NE-I is a short-neck butterfly valve in 2–12 in (50–300 mm), wafer or lug, for process flowlines, utilities and food and beverage lines between ASME Class 125/150 flanges. Ratings are 200 psi, 285 psi and throttling, available from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series NE-I is a short-neck butterfly valve in 2–12 in (50–300 mm), wafer or lug, installed between ASME Class 125/150 flanges. The demco ne-i butterfly valve has the widest body-material choice of the neck patterns and is used on process flowlines, utilities and food and beverage lines.

How it is built

The cartridge seat is hard-backed, slip-fitted and replaced without special tools. The dry stem journal and its raised band with two O-ring ribs form a triple stem seal, and the rectangular drive positions the disc. At 2 in the neck dimension C is 100 mm and D is 171 mm, so this pattern is shorter than the long-neck NE-C, whose neck clears 2 in of insulation. The general NE-I is not the sanitary version.

Sizes and ratings

The size table lists 72 part numbers: nine sizes, each wafer and lug on a shared base number, at 200 psi drop-tight shut-off (22128–22136), 285 psi (22252–22260) and throttling (22270–22278). The body is rated ASME Class 150 (285 psi non-shock).

  • Stem: 416 SS, or 316 SS (17-4PH upper stem on 8–12 in). Disc: nickel-plated ductile iron, aluminium bronze or 316 SS.
  • Seats: Buna-N 0 to 180 °F, EPDM 20 to 275 °F, FKM 20 to 300 °F, natural rubber −30 to 150 °F.
  • MSS SP-67 on request; ABS, CE/PED, CRN, DNV and EAC on selected sizes and ratings only.

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue also lists a 50 psi drop-tight rating for this valve, base 22261, 22262, 22263, 22264, 22265, 22266, 22267, 22268, 22269. The 2018 brochure no longer prints it, so we confirm availability when we quote.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO NE-I butterfly valve and where is it used?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-I is a short-neck butterfly valve in 2–12 in, wafer or lug, for food and beverage lines, utilities and process flowlines between ASME Class 125/150 flanges. It has the wide body-material choice of the neck patterns. Its 2 in neck dimension C is 100 mm and D is 171 mm.

faqs.question: Which sizes and ratings does the DEMCO NE-I 2–12 in butterfly valve come in?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-I covers 2 in (50 mm) to 12 in (300 mm), wafer or lug. Each size is listed at 200 psi drop-tight shut-off, 285 psi and throttling (0 psi), and a 50 psi option is also offered. The size table lists 72 part numbers, such as 22130, 22254 and 22272 for 3 in.

faqs.question: What do a DEMCO NE-I 3 in valve weigh and measure?
faqs.answer: A DEMCO NE-I 3 in valve is 47 mm face to face and weighs 3.1 kg as a wafer or 4.4 kg as a lug. Its dimensions are C 124 mm, D 208 mm and E 137 mm. The base numbers are 22130 at 200 psi, 22254 at 285 psi and 22272 for throttling.

faqs.question: Which body materials are available on the DEMCO NE-I butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-I body is ductile iron (wafer only, code 1), aluminium bronze (3), carbon steel (4) or stainless steel (8). Stems are 416 SS or 316 SS, with a 17-4PH upper stem on 8–12 in, and discs are nickel-plated ductile iron, aluminium bronze or 316 SS. A bronze-body 2 in wafer is listed in the weight data.

faqs.question: How do I choose the seat elastomer for a DEMCO NE-I butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Choose from fluid and temperature. Buna-N (31) handles hydrocarbons from 0 to 180 °F; EPDM (35) handles water, alkalis and saturated steam from 20 to 275 °F, not oil; FKM (34) from 20 to 300 °F suits harsh chemicals; natural rubber (36) from −30 to 150 °F suits abrasives. The same seat codes apply across the NE-I part numbers.

faqs.question: How is a DEMCO NE-I part number built?
faqs.answer: A NE-I number is prefix, base number, hyphen and digits. J0 22131-5 3 1 4 35 6 is a 4 in lug, 200 psi valve: 5 lug, 3 aluminium bronze body, 1 for a 416 SS stem, 4 for an aluminium bronze disc, 35 for EPDM and 6 for a two-position handle. F0 replaces J0 for fire-safe builds.

faqs.question: Which spares fit the DEMCO NE-I 2–12 in butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Cartridge seats, discs, stems, bearings, pins and O-rings are carried as separate numbers, and the NE-I seat is slip-fit with no special tools. Quote the valve base number, such as 22132 for 5 in at 200 psi, plus the elastomer. The [replacement discs](/p/demco-butterfly-valve-replacement-discs-2-24) listing gives the disc codes.

faqs.question: What standards and fire testing apply to the DEMCO NE-I butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-I is tested to MSS SP-67 on request and marked to MSS SP-25. ABS, CE/PED, CRN, DNV, EAC and API 607 4th Ed fire-tested builds (F0 prefix) apply on selected sizes and ratings only, so confirm the 6 in or 8 in size you need at quotation before relying on a marine or fire-safe claim.

faqs.question: DEMCO NE-I or NE-C: which should I specify at 4 in?
faqs.answer: Specify the NE-I when the valve sits in an uninsulated line and the NE-C when the neck must clear 2 in of insulation. At 4 in the NE-I has C 152 mm and weighs 4.6 kg as a wafer, and the NE-C has a longer neck for that insulation clearance. Both are ASME Class 150 bodies.

faqs.question: How should a DEMCO NE-I butterfly valve be installed?
faqs.answer: Install the DEMCO NE-I in the closed position between flanges, with studs or capscrews, and centre the wafer body in a Class 150 pattern. No regular maintenance or lubrication is needed. Torque at 285 psi is 765 in·lbf at 4 in and 4,125 in·lbf at 10 in, and throttling needs 700 in·lbf at 10 in.

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO NE-I butterfly valve suitable for end-of-line service?
faqs.answer: No. The DEMCO NE-I is not end-of-line capable, so a 6 in or 10 in valve must have downstream flanging. It seals bidirectionally at full rating inside ASME Class 125/150 flanges. For sanitary service, use the separate NE-I Sanitary listing, since this general NE-I is not an FDA valve.

faqs.answer: The DEMCO NF-C takes Buna-N (0 to 180 °F), FKM (20 to 300 °F), EPDM (20 to 275 °F) or natural rubber (−30 to 150 °F). Choose EPDM for water and saturated steam, Buna-N for hydrocarbons. A 16 in valve at 150 psi is base 23821 and the seat digits are 31, 34, 35 or 36.

faqs.question: How do I read a DEMCO NF-C part number such as J0 23821?
faqs.answer: J0 23821-5 1 1 5 31 A reads as a non-fire-safe 16 in, 150 psi NF-C: 5 lug, 1 ductile iron body, 1 for a 416 SS stem, 5 for a nickel-plated ductile iron disc, 31 for Buna-N and A for a worm gear with handwheel. F0 is the fire-safe prefix.

faqs.question: Which spare parts fit the DEMCO NF-C valves?
faqs.answer: Seats, discs, stems, pins, retainers and bearings are listed for the NF-C in 14–24 in. Quote the base number, such as 23822 for 18 in at 150 psi, with the elastomer. The [replacement seats](/p/demco-butterfly-valve-replacement-seats-2-24) listing carries the cartridge seat numbers.

faqs.question: How should a DEMCO NF-C large-bore butterfly valve be operated?
faqs.answer: Worm-gear operators are listed with a handwheel (code A) or a bare shaft (code E), and Series DR actuators fit the top flange. Published torque at 285 psi is 15,000 in·lbf at 14 in and 90,000 in·lbf at 36 in, against 7,740 and 67,500 at 150 psi.

faqs.question: DEMCO NF-C or NE-C: which for a 14 in line?
faqs.answer: The NE-C stops at 12 in, so the DEMCO NF-C is the 14 in choice. Standard shut-off steps down to 150 psi from the 200 psi of the NE-C, with 285 psi as the option. A 14 in NF-C is 76 mm face to face and its 150 psi base is 23820.

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO NF-C suitable for end-of-line service or fire-safe duty?
faqs.answer: No, the DEMCO NF-C is not end-of-line capable. API 607 4th Ed fire-tested builds with the F0 prefix, ABS, CE/PED, CRN, DNV and EAC exist on selected sizes and ratings only. The 24 in valve is 152 mm face to face.

faqs.question: How is a DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve installed?
faqs.answer: Install the DEMCO NF-C closed between flanges, with studs or capscrews, and no regular lubrication is needed. Face-to-face length is 165 mm at 30 in and 200 mm at 36 in, so allow for it in the spool. At 16 in the face-to-face length is 102 mm.

faqs.question: How do I order a DEMCO NF-C butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Send size, rating (150 or 285 psi), wafer or lug, body, disc, seat elastomer, operator and quantity through [our contact page](/contact). For a 24 in lug at 285 psi, quote base 25322. Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

products.focusKeyword: demco ne-d sp butterfly valve
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO Series NE-D SP is the short-pattern version of the NE-D: a wafer butterfly valve with a square stem in 2–12 in (no 2½ in), 200 psi drop-tight shut-off and an ASME Class 150 body, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series NE-D SP is the short-pattern version of the NE-D: a wafer butterfly valve with a square stem, in 2–12 in with no 2½ in size, rated 200 psi drop-tight. The demco ne-d sp butterfly valve fits between ASME Class 125/150 flanges with a shorter face-to-face length than the NE-D.

Short pattern and square stem

Face-to-face length (dimension A) is 41.15 mm at 2 in, against 44 mm on the NE-D, and 50.80 mm at 4 in against 54 mm. The stem is square, R SQ 0.624 in on 2–6 in, 0.874 in on 8–10 in and 1.124 in on 12 in. The body is ductile iron and rated ASME Class 150 (285 psi non-shock), with a vacuum rating of 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). Published torque at 200 psi is 450 in·lbf at 4 in and 2,650 in·lbf at 10 in, and operators are handles, worm-gear operators or actuators on the standard top flange.

Sizes and part numbers

The size table lists 8 part numbers, one per size from 2 in to 12 in.

  • Seats: Buna-N, FKM, EPDM or natural rubber, hard-backed cartridge type.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO NE-D SP butterfly valve and where is it used?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-D SP is the short-pattern version of the NE-D, a wafer butterfly valve with a square stem in 2–12 in. It trims the NE-D face-to-face length: a 6 in valve is 53.85 mm against 57 mm. It is rated 200 psi drop-tight in an ASME Class 150 body.

faqs.question: Which sizes and ratings does the DEMCO NE-D SP 2–12 in butterfly valve come in?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-D SP is listed at 200 psi drop-tight shut-off only, in 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 and 12 in; there is no 2½ in. The size table lists 8 part numbers, from 2326563 at 2 in to 2326567 at 10 in. The body is rated ASME Class 150 (285 psi non-shock).

faqs.question: What are the face-to-face length and weight of a DEMCO NE-D SP 8 in valve?
faqs.answer: A DEMCO NE-D SP 8 in valve is 64.52 mm face to face and weighs 12.9 kg, against 65 mm on the standard NE-D. Its base number is 2326569. The square stem on 8 in and 10 in valves is R SQ 0.874 in.

faqs.question: What is the stem size on a DEMCO NE-D SP butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-D SP has a square stem: R SQ 0.624 in on 2–6 in, 0.874 in on 8–10 in and 1.124 in on 12 in. A 5 in valve (base 2326565) therefore has the 0.624 in square. Check the operator bore against that size before you order a handle or gear operator.

faqs.question: Which materials does the DEMCO NE-D SP butterfly valve use?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO NE-D SP body is ductile iron. Stems are 416 SS, or 316 SS as an option with a 17-4PH upper stem on 8–12 in, and discs are nickel-plated ductile iron, aluminium bronze or 316 SS. ZPEX-coated ductile iron is an option. A 10 in valve weighs 20.3 kg.

faqs.question: Which seat elastomer and temperature range suit a DEMCO NE-D SP valve?
faqs.answer: Choose by fluid. Buna-N runs 0 to 180 °F for hydrocarbons, EPDM 20 to 275 °F for water, alkalis and saturated steam (not oil), FKM 20 to 300 °F for harsh chemicals (not hot water or steam) and natural rubber −30 to 150 °F for abrasion. Quote the elastomer with base 2326566 for a 6 in.

faqs.question: How is a DEMCO NE-D SP part number written?
faqs.answer: A DEMCO NE-D SP number is a seven-digit base, such as 2326497 for 4 in, followed by the configuration suffix that selects disc, stem and seat. The 12 in base number is confirmed at quotation. Fire-safe builds use the F0 prefix in place of J0, on selected sizes and ratings only.

faqs.question: Which spare parts fit the DEMCO NE-D SP butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: The cartridge seat is slip-fit and replaced without special tools, and discs, stems, pins and O-rings are separate numbers. Quote the base, such as 2326563 for 2 in, and the elastomer, and the fit is confirmed at quotation. See the [replacement seats](/p/demco-butterfly-valve-replacement-seats-2-24).

faqs.question: DEMCO NE-D SP or NE-D: which should I choose for a 4 in line?
faqs.answer: Choose the NE-D SP when the 54 mm NE-D length does not fit and a square stem is wanted: the 4 in SP is 50.80 mm and weighs 4.6 kg. Choose the NE-D for 285 psi or throttling, which the SP does not list. The SP 4 in base is 2326497.

faqs.question: What torque and installation steps apply to a DEMCO NE-D SP butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Install the DEMCO NE-D SP closed between flanges, with studs or capscrews, no regular lubrication needed. At 200 psi the published torque is 450 in·lbf at 4 in, 900 in·lbf at 6 in and 2,650 in·lbf at 10 in. Size the operator for the stem square as well as the torque.

faqs.question: How do I order a DEMCO NE-D SP butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Send size, seat elastomer, disc material, operator and quantity through [our contact page](/contact). For a 3 in valve quote base 2326564, and say so if the square stem needs a particular operator. Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

products.title: DEMCO Marine Series Butterfly Valve, USCG 46 CFR 56 & ABS, 2″–36″
products.focusKeyword: demco marine butterfly valve
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO Marine Series is a fire-safe butterfly valve range in 2–36 in (50–900 mm), built on NE-C, NE-I, NE-D and NF-C bodies for 46 CFR Part 56 piping, with ABS, DNV, PED and CRN suffixes on selected sizes, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Marine Series is a butterfly valve range in 2–36 in (50–900 mm) for marine piping to 46 CFR Part 56. USCG Category (A) acceptance applies on API 607 qualified valves, and ABS, DNV, PED and CRN certification suffixes are available on selected sizes and ratings only. The demco marine butterfly valve is ordered with the F0 fire-safe prefix.

Body styles and sizes

The marine range uses the NE-C lug, NE-I lug and wafer, NE-D wafer and NF-C lug bodies; the 30 and 36 in sizes are ductile iron lug only. Rated working pressures are 200 psi or 285 psi on 2–12 in, and 150 psi or 285 psi on 14–36 in. The size table lists 48 part numbers. Operators are handles, worm-gear operators or actuators on the standard top flange, and seats are Buna-N, FKM, EPDM or natural rubber.

Size200 psi base285 psi base

6 in2292822919

From 14 in the 150 psi bases are 24611–24615 and 285 psi bases 25302–25308; a 14 in lug weighs 52.6 kg and a 30 in lug 476.3 kg.

Testing and certification

  • MSS SP-25 tagging and MSS SP-67 testing.
  • Shell test at 1-1/2 × rated working pressure; seat test at rated working pressure.
  • Certification suffix: 01 ABS, 02 DNV, 03 PED, 04 CRN, on selected sizes and ratings only.
  • API 607 4th Ed fire-tested builds are likewise limited to selected sizes and ratings, so confirm the size and rating you need before you rely on the F0 prefix.

Reading the part number

The brochure example 22928-1114311 is a 6 in, 200 psi valve: wafer, ductile iron body, 416 SS stem, aluminium bronze disc, Buna-N seat and a ten-position handle, with the F0 prefix in front. The large sizes are built on the NF-C large-bore valve.

Send size, rating, body style and certification through our contact page; Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

50 psi and 30–36 in marine valves (2015 catalogue)

The 2015 DEMCO Butterfly Valves catalogue adds marine 50 psi bases and the 30 and 36 in NF-C ductile iron lug valves: 2227184, 2227185, 22932, 22933, 22934, 22935, 22936, 22937, 22938, 22939, 22940, 24653, 24654, 24655, 24656, 24657. We confirm availability when we quote.
