faqs.question: What is the DEMCO Marine Series butterfly valve and where is it used?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO Marine Series is a butterfly valve range in 2–36 in for marine piping to 46 CFR Part 56, with USCG Category (A) acceptance on API 607 qualified valves (selected sizes and ratings only). It is built on NE-C, NE-I, NE-D and NF-C bodies. A 6 in valve is base 22928 at 200 psi.

faqs.question: Which sizes and ratings does the DEMCO Marine butterfly valve cover from 2 to 36 in?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO Marine Series covers 2–36 in. Standard shut-off is 200 psi on 2–12 in and 150 psi on 14–36 in, with a 285 psi option, inside an ASME Class 150 body. The size table lists 48 part numbers, from 22923 at 2 in to 25307 at 30 in.

faqs.question: What do DEMCO Marine 14 in and 30 in lug valves weigh?
faqs.answer: A DEMCO Marine 14 in NF-C lug valve weighs 52.6 kg and a 30 in lug weighs 476.3 kg. The 14 in bases are 24611 at 150 psi and 25302 at 285 psi; the 30 in bases are 2227182 and 25307. The 30 and 36 in sizes are ductile iron lug only.

faqs.question: Which body materials are used on the DEMCO Marine butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: DEMCO Marine valves are ductile iron, with aluminium bronze, carbon steel and stainless steel options on the smaller sizes. Stems are 416 SS or 316 SS, and discs are nickel-plated ductile iron, aluminium bronze or 316 SS. On the 24 in lug the weight is 242.7 kg, and the 30 in is ductile iron lug only.

faqs.question: Which seat elastomer should I choose on a DEMCO Marine valve, and what are the limits?
faqs.answer: Buna-N covers 0 to 180 °F, EPDM 20 to 275 °F, FKM 20 to 300 °F and natural rubber −30 to 150 °F, so choose by fluid and temperature. For example, a 10 in marine valve at 285 psi is base 22921, with the seat code 31, 34, 35 or 36 in the number.

faqs.question: How do I read a DEMCO Marine part number such as F0 22928-1114311?
faqs.answer: F0 marks the fire-safe prefix, 22928 is the 6 in, 200 psi base, and 1114311 reads wafer, ductile iron body, 416 SS stem, aluminium bronze disc, Buna-N seat (31) and a ten-position handle. A certification suffix follows on selected sizes and ratings only: 01 ABS, 02 DNV, 03 PED or 04 CRN.

faqs.question: Which certifications and tests apply to the DEMCO Marine butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO Marine range carries MSS SP-25 tagging and MSS SP-67 testing, with a shell test at 1-1/2 × rated working pressure and a seat test at rated working pressure. ABS, DNV, PED and CRN apply on selected sizes and ratings only. Name the class society when you request a 20 in valve.

faqs.question: What spares fit the DEMCO Marine butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Seats, discs, stems, pins, retainers and O-rings are separate parts, and the fit is confirmed at quotation against the marine base, such as 22930 for 10 in at 200 psi, and the elastomer. The [replacement seats](/p/demco-butterfly-valve-replacement-seats-2-24) listing carries the cartridge seat numbers.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the DEMCO Marine and a standard NE-C butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: The marine range is ordered with the F0 fire-safe prefix and is built for 46 CFR Part 56 with USCG Category (A) acceptance on API 607 qualified valves, while a standard NE-C is J0 non-fire-safe unless F0 is specified. Fire-tested builds exist on selected sizes and ratings only. The marine 2 in at 285 psi is 22914.

faqs.question: How should a DEMCO Marine butterfly valve be installed and operated?
faqs.answer: Install it closed between flanges, with studs or capscrews, with no regular lubrication. Operators are handles, worm-gear operators or actuators on the standard top flange. Published torque at 285 psi is 765 in·lbf at 4 in and 20,500 in·lbf at 16 in, so size a 16 in operator accordingly.

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO Marine butterfly valve suitable for end-of-line service?
faqs.answer: No. The DEMCO Marine Series is not end-of-line capable, so a 3 in or 18 in valve needs downstream flanging. It seals both ways at full rating and has a vacuum rating of 10 µm (29.9 in Hg).

faqs.question: How do I order a DEMCO Marine butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Send size, rating, body style, seat elastomer, certification suffix (ABS, DNV, PED or CRN, on selected sizes and ratings only) and quantity through [our contact page](/contact). For a 4 in valve at 285 psi quote base 22917. Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

products.title: DEMCO Series NE-I Sanitary Butterfly Valve (FDA), 2″–12″
products.focusKeyword: demco series ne-i sanitary butterfly valve (fda)
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO Series NE-I Sanitary is a wafer butterfly valve with FDA-approved wetted parts for food, beverage and pharmaceutical lines, 2–12 in, 200 psi drop-tight shut-off. Eight base numbers, 23150 to 23157, are quoted from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series NE-I Sanitary butterfly valve is a wafer valve for sanitary lines, with FDA-approved wetted parts and a 200 psi drop-tight shut-off. The size table lists 8 part numbers from 2 in to 12 in; the 5 in size is not available.

How it is built

The disc is an investment casting with reduced stem bosses. Drilled passageways vent the disc interior, so no closed chamber is left in the valve. The stem journal is dry. When the mating flange compresses the projecting seat face, it forms a smooth flow way. Handle parts are bronze with stainless fasteners for caustic washdown.

Sizes, ratings and weights

  • Bases 23150 (2 in), 23151 (2½ in), 23152 (3 in), 23153 (4 in), 23154 (6 in), 23155 (8 in), 23156 (10 in) and 23157 (12 in).
  • ASME Class 150 body, 285 psi non-shock, with 200 psi drop-tight shut-off.
  • Bare-stem weight runs from 2.2 kg at 2 in to 30.3 kg at 12 in.
  • Not suited to end-of-line service.

Materials and trim

Bodies come in bronze, 316 stainless steel (CF8M), aluminium or electroless nickel-coated ductile iron. Stems are 316 stainless steel, with a 17-4 PH SS upper stem on 8–12 in. Discs are 316 SS, polished, tumbled or unpolished. Seats are food-grade EPT, EPDM or Buna-N, compliant with FDA 21 CFR 177.2600.

Reading the part number

The sanitary valve bases run in sequence, so 23150 is the 2 in valve, 23153 the 4 in, 23154 the 6 in and 23157 the 12 in. Weights are bare stem, from 4.9 lb to 66.8 lb across the iron, steel and stainless wafer sizes. Dimensions A, C, D and E for every size are in millimetres in the size table on this page.

Handles and operators

Sanitary handles are bronze with stainless fasteners, in 10-position, 2-position and throttling styles, covering 2–4, 5–6, 8, 10 and 12 in. Weatherproof worm-gear operators and Series DR pneumatic actuators are also listed for the range.

Source of the data and ordering

The part numbers and dimensions come from the 2015 DEMCO butterfly valve catalogue, pages 7, 12 and 20. Indus confirms the current build or part number against the nameplate when it quotes. For Teflon-lined service see the DEMCO NEI-T.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO Series NE-I Sanitary butterfly valve used for?
faqs.answer: It is a wafer butterfly valve for food, beverage, dairy and pharmaceutical lines, built with FDA-approved wetted parts. It gives 200 psi drop-tight shut-off in sizes 2–12 in. Bases 23150 to 23157 cover the range, and the valve is not suited to end-of-line service.

faqs.question: Which sizes does the DEMCO NE-I Sanitary come in, and is 5 in available?
faqs.answer: It comes in 2, 2½, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 in, which is DN 50 to DN 300, as bases 23150 to 23157. The 5 in (125 mm) size is not available. It is a wafer body only, so there is no lug version of the sanitary valve.

faqs.question: What pressure does the DEMCO NE-I Sanitary hold, and what about vacuum?
faqs.answer: The body is ASME Class 150 at 285 psi non-shock, and drop-tight shut-off is 200 psi on all eight sizes from base 23150 to 23157. Vacuum sealing is 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The valve is not capable of end-of-line service, so downstream flanges are needed.

faqs.question: How heavy is the DEMCO NE-I Sanitary 12 in valve and what are its dimensions?
faqs.answer: Base 23157 for 12 in weighs 30.3 kg bare stem. Dimensions A/C/D/E from the 2015 catalogue, page 20, are 82/277/518/409 mm. The 2 in valve 23150 is 2.2 kg at 44/100/171/105 mm. Weights rise steadily between those two sizes.

faqs.question: What materials is the DEMCO NE-I Sanitary 6 in valve available in?
faqs.answer: Bodies come in bronze, 316 stainless steel (CF8M), aluminium or electroless nickel-coated ductile iron. Stems are 316 stainless steel and discs are 316 SS, polished, tumbled or unpolished. On base 23154 for 6 in the stem is 316; the 17-4 PH upper stem applies to 8–12 in only.

faqs.question: Which seat elastomers does the DEMCO NE-I Sanitary use and are they FDA compliant?
faqs.answer: Food-grade EPT (peroxide-cured), sulfur-cured food-grade EPDM and peroxide-cured food-grade Buna-N are listed, all compliant with FDA 21 CFR 177.2600. Black neoprene, Viton and white neoprene are also available. Choose by the process fluid and wash chemicals, and state the seat on the 23153 enquiry for 4 in.

faqs.question: What temperature range does the DEMCO NE-I Sanitary cover?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO butterfly range runs from −30 to 300 °F, depending on the seat fitted, so the elastomer you choose sets the limit for your line. For a 3 in valve on base 23152, state the process and washdown temperatures and Indus confirms the seat at quotation.

faqs.question: How do I read DEMCO NE-I Sanitary part number 23155?
faqs.answer: 23155 is the 2015 base number for the 8 in NE-I Sanitary wafer valve, 12.9 kg. The sanitary bases run in sequence from 23150 for 2 in to 23157 for 12 in, skipping 5 in. Seat, body and disc choices are specified in the enquiry and confirmed against the nameplate.

faqs.question: Which handles and operators fit the DEMCO NE-I Sanitary 10 in valve?
faqs.answer: Sanitary handles in bronze with stainless parts come as 10-position (22319 to 22323), 2-position (22324 to 22328) and throttling (22329 to 22333) types. For a 10 in valve 23156 the handle bases are 22322, 22327 and 22332. Gear operators and Series DR actuators are also listed.

faqs.question: What approvals apply to the DEMCO NE-I Sanitary 2½ in valve?
faqs.answer: The butterfly range is built to MSS SP-67 and SP-25. ABS, CE/PED, CRN, DNV, EAC and API 607 4th Ed fire-test approvals apply on selected sizes and ratings only. For base 23151, ask which of them apply and Indus confirms against the nameplate when it quotes.

faqs.question: DEMCO NE-I Sanitary or NEI-T Teflon-lined valve: which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Choose the NE-I Sanitary (base 23150 for 2 in, 200 psi drop-tight) for food-grade elastomer seats. Choose the [NEI-T](/p/demco-series-nei-t-teflon-lined-sanitary-butterfly-valve-2-10) when a Teflon liner must cover the seat faces, at 150 psi drop-tight in 2–10 in, with no 12 in size.

faqs.question: How do I order a DEMCO NE-I Sanitary butterfly valve and how is it fitted?
faqs.answer: Send the base number (for example 23157 for 12 in), body, disc and seat materials, handle type and quantity through [/contact](/contact), and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Fit it closed between flanges using studs or capscrews; it needs no regular lubrication.

products.title: DEMCO Series NEI-T Teflon-Lined Sanitary Butterfly Valve, 2″–10″
products.focusKeyword: demco series nei-t teflon-lined sanitary butterfly valve
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO Series NEI-T is a Teflon-lined butterfly valve for sanitary and corrosive lines, 2–10 in in wafer or lug body, 150 psi drop-tight. Seven base numbers, 24680 to 24686, are quoted from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series NEI-T Teflon-lined sanitary butterfly valve covers 2–10 in in wafer or lug bodies, with a 150 psi drop-tight shut-off. A virgin Teflon liner covers the seat faces, so no elastomer touches the line fluid. The size table lists 7 part numbers.

How it is built / seat design

The seat is a virgin Teflon liner overlaid and bonded to an EPDM cushion. The cushion gives the resilience for sealing, and the liner keeps the elastomer out of the flow. The stem journal is dry and the valve sits closed between flanges. It needs no regular maintenance or lubrication.

Sizes, ratings and weights

  • Bases 24680 (2 in), 24681 (2½ in), 24682 (3 in), 24683 (4 in), 24684 (6 in), 24685 (8 in) and 24686 (10 in).
  • ASME Class 150 body, 285 psi non-shock; 150 psi drop-tight shut-off.
  • Wafer weights run from 4.9 lb at 2 in to 44.8 lb at 10 in, bare stem.
  • Not suited to end-of-line service.

Materials and trim

Bodies include ductile iron, gray iron (lug long-neck), aluminium bronze, carbon steel, aluminium (wafer only), 316 stainless steel and Hastelloy C. Stems are 316 stainless, Monel or Hastelloy C. Discs are 316 SS, Alloy 20 or Hastelloy C.

Reading the part number

The NEI-T bases run in sequence, so 24680 is the 2 in valve, 24683 the 4 in and 24686 the 10 in. Dimensions A, C, D and E for every size are in millimetres in the size table on this page, and wafer weights are bare stem. Lug steel and stainless bodies run from 7.0 lb to 64.9 lb.

Handles and operators

Sanitary or corrosion-resistant lever handles, weatherproof worm-gear operators and Series DR pneumatic actuators are listed. State the duty, on-off or throttling, and the operator when you enquire.

Source of the data and ordering

Bases and dimensions come from the 2015 DEMCO butterfly valve catalogue, pages 7, 12 and 21. Indus confirms the current build or part number against the nameplate when it quotes. For food-grade elastomer seats see the NE-I Sanitary.

products.seoDescription: DEMCO NEI-T Teflon-lined sanitary butterfly valve, 2–10 in, wafer and lug, 150 psi drop-tight. Bases 24680 to 24686, weights and dimensions.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO Series NEI-T Teflon-lined butterfly valve used for?
faqs.answer: It is a lined butterfly valve for sanitary lines and corrosive chemical service, where the virgin Teflon liner covers the seat faces so no elastomer touches the fluid. It comes in 2–10 in, wafer or lug, with 150 psi drop-tight shut-off. Bases run from 24680 to 24686.

faqs.question: Which sizes and body styles does the DEMCO NEI-T come in?
faqs.answer: Sizes are 2, 2½, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 10 in (DN 50 to DN 250), as bases 24680 to 24686. Each is available as a wafer (short-neck) or lug (long-neck) body. There is no 12 in NEI-T in this series, unlike the NE-I Sanitary, which goes to 12 in.

faqs.question: What shut-off pressure and vacuum does the DEMCO NEI-T 4 in valve hold?
faqs.answer: Drop-tight shut-off is 150 psi on every size, and the body is ASME Class 150 at 285 psi non-shock. Vacuum sealing is 10 µm (29.9 in Hg). The 4 in valve, base 24683, is not capable of end-of-line service, so downstream flanges are needed.

faqs.question: How heavy is the DEMCO NEI-T 10 in valve and what are its dimensions?
faqs.answer: Base 24686 for 10 in weighs 20.3 kg bare stem as a wafer. Dimensions A/C/D/E from the 2015 catalogue, page 21, are 70/253/442/340 mm. The 2 in valve 24680 is 2.2 kg at 44/100/171/105 mm. Lug bodies in steel or SS weigh more, from 7.0 lb.

faqs.question: What temperature range does the DEMCO NEI-T cover?
faqs.answer: The DEMCO butterfly range runs from −30 to 300 °F, depending on the seat fitted. In the NEI-T the Teflon liner faces the fluid, but the cushion behind it still matters. For a 6 in valve on base 24684, state the process temperature and Indus confirms the build at quotation.

faqs.question: What materials is the DEMCO NEI-T 8 in valve available in?
faqs.answer: Bodies include ductile iron, gray iron (lug long-neck), aluminium bronze, carbon steel, aluminium (wafer only), 316 stainless steel and Hastelloy C. Stems are 316 stainless, Monel or Hastelloy C, and discs are 316 SS, Alloy 20 or Hastelloy C. State your choices when you enquire about base 24685.

faqs.question: What seat does the DEMCO NEI-T use, and which elastomer sits behind the liner?
faqs.answer: The seat is a virgin Teflon liner overlaid and bonded to an elastomer cushion. The 2015 catalogue shows an EPDM cushion, and Buna-N/Teflon and EPDM/Teflon (peroxide-cured or sulfur-cured) are also listed. Indus confirms the cushion against the nameplate for 2½ in base 24681 at quotation.

faqs.question: DEMCO NEI-T or standard NE-I valve: when is the Teflon liner needed?
faqs.answer: Choose the NEI-T (150 psi drop-tight, bases 24680 to 24686) when the fluid must not touch an elastomer, such as aggressive chemicals. Choose the standard [NE-I Sanitary](/p/demco-series-ne-i-sanitary-butterfly-valve-fda-2-12) at 200 psi drop-tight when food-grade elastomer seats are acceptable.

faqs.question: Which operators fit the DEMCO NEI-T 3 in valve?
faqs.answer: Sanitary or corrosion-resistant lever handles, weatherproof worm-gear operators and Series DR pneumatic actuators are listed. A 3 in valve on base 24682 takes the 2–4 in handle size. For a buried or tank-bottom line, a [stem extension](/p/demco-stem-extension-for-butterfly-valves-2-24) can carry the operator away from the valve.

faqs.question: How do I read DEMCO NEI-T part number 24683?
faqs.answer: 24683 is the 2015 base number for the 4 in NEI-T, 4.6 kg bare stem, at 54/138/236/175 mm A/C/D/E. The bases run in sequence from 24680 for 2 in to 24686 for 10 in. Body style, materials and seat are specified in the enquiry and confirmed against the nameplate.

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO NEI-T 2 in valve covered by sanitary or marine approvals?
faqs.answer: The NEI-T is listed for sanitary service, and the butterfly range is built to MSS SP-67 and SP-25. ABS, CE/PED, CRN, DNV, EAC and API 607 4th Ed fire-test approvals apply on selected sizes and ratings only. Ask Indus about base 24680 and the approval you need.

faqs.question: How do I order a DEMCO NEI-T Teflon-lined butterfly valve?
faqs.answer: Send the base number (24685 for 8 in, for example), wafer or lug, body, disc and stem materials, seat, operator and quantity through [/contact](/contact), and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. The data here is from the 2015 catalogue, so the nameplate governs.
